title: Rounded LPC Water Depth Contour Repair
changes: Isolated the remaining Z35 visual regression to exact mapped mixed shallow/deep water tuple cells.
Changed the retained terrain cache to use a pure owner-water fill for mixed depth tuples while preserving exact mapped tuples for land, banks, shorelines, and junctions.
Re-registered the authored LPC transition module and limited its runtime overlay to the rounded shallow_rim_over_deep family.
Kept the exact-pair transition atlas as the no-direct-source compatibility fallback.
Added unit and content-integrity protection against reintroducing hard rectangular mapped water-depth bands.
